clauses.clause: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature.
If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
Whenever another nontoken creature dies, draw a card.

mapping.notes: Library Larcenist's attack trigger with Dire Fleet Warmonger's verified 'you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, ...' and a counter on this creature; a CreatureDiesEvent over any other nontoken creature draws. Flying compiled. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: high_society_hunter_declined_sacrifice_no_counter.

clauses.evidence: Cast: 'keywords +FLYING'. 'this creature attacks and opp_giant blocks it': no DECLARE_BLOCKERS row, the Hunter deals 6 to the opponent: a non-flier cannot block it. F06_6 (a ground creature is never asked to block the Hunter; a reach creature is).

clauses.clause: Whenever this creature attacks, you may sacrifice another creature.
clauses.evidence: 'this creature attacks alone, unblocked': 'ask may: [fire, skip] -> fire', 'ask sacrifice: [you_bear, you_giant] -> you_bear' (only your other creatures: not itself, not the opponent's, not the relic or the charm), 'you_bear moves battlefield -> graveyard (by card/SACRIFICE)'. The decline (skip) is not in the trace: F06_2 (skip: nothing happens), F06_3 (no other creature: nothing sacrificed).

clauses.clause: If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: 'card gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s) (by card/PUT_COUNTER)', 'counters {} -> {PLUS_1_PLUS_1: 1}; P/T 5/3 -> 6/4' after the sacrifice (one counter). Without a sacrifice: F06_2, F06_3 (no counter).

clauses.clause: Whenever another nontoken creature dies, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: 'your creature (you_bear) dies': 'card's triggered ability [1] triggers', 'you draws'; 'an opponent's creature (opp_bear) dies': the same (any controller); 'this card is dealt lethal damage -> none' ('another'); one card each. Two deaths at once: F06_5.

clauses.clause: (nontoken: a token that dies draws no card)
clauses.evidence: No token dies in the probe, so the 'nontoken' filter is never tested. F06_4 (a sacrificed token and the opponent's dying token: no card; the opponent's nontoken creature: one card).
